items.title: Encoding one-point intersections of four-element sets by zero- and two-point intersections

items.difficulty_reason: Five disjoint sunflower cores are recovered from pairwise constraints and then forced into A_ij as exact two-core unions. The resulting pair-sum equations recover the one-point intersection of the two specified sets, and the explicit forward construction gives the converse.
